objects.name: Analytic 2276
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies a write to alarm threshold configuration on an Human-Machine Interface (HMI)/alarm server from a process other than the recognized alarm management application, without a corresponding operator session. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect. Suppress activity that fully matches approved maintenance, commissioning, failover, recovery, or tested control procedures.
